title: Grammar Exam Drill: Tenses, Conjunctions ve Question Tags
subtitle: Son dersteki dilbilgisi konularını dönüşüm ve sınav sorularıyla pekiştir.

learn.title: Tense seç, fikri bağla, cevabı doğrula
learn.intro: Bu paket yalnızca son dersteki sınav konularını kapsar. Önce zaman ipucunu ve eylemin durumunu bul; sonra doğru tense, conjunction veya question tag yapısını seç.

cards.title: Present simple / continuous
cards.text: Present simple rutin ve genel gerçek; present continuous şu anda veya geçici olarak devam eden eylem içindir.

cards.title: Past simple / continuous
cards.text: Past simple tamamlanan olay; past continuous geçmişte belirli bir anda sürmekte olan sahnedir.
examples: Leo was writing when the bell rang.

cards.title: Present perfect
cards.text: Bugüne bağlantısı olan sonuç, deneyim veya durum. have/has + V3.
examples: We have known Arda for years.

cards.title: Present perfect continuous
cards.text: Geçmişte başlayıp hâlâ süren veya etkisi görülen aktivite. have/has been + V-ing.
examples: I have been revising since nine.
They have been practising for two hours.

cards.title: Conjunctions
cards.text: And ek bilgi, but/although karşıtlık, because sebep, so sonuç, when kısa olay, while devam eden sahne verir.
examples: I revised because the exam was near.
While I was reading, the phone rang.

cards.title: Question tags
cards.text: Olumlu cümleye olumsuz; olumsuz cümleye olumlu kısa soru ekle. Yardımcı fiil ve zamir ana cümleyle eşleşir.

cards.title: Tense transformations
cards.text: Anlamı koruyarak yardımcı fiili, ana fiil biçimini ve zaman ifadesini birlikte değiştir.
examples: She studies every day. → She is studying now.
They started at nine and continue. → They have been working since nine.

read.title: The Revision Evening
read.instructions: Metni oku; tense ipuçlarını, conjunctions ve question tags yapılarını bul.

tokens.text: Mina usually revises in the library, but she is studying at home tonight.
She has completed two worksheets and has been practising question tags for an hour.
Yesterday, she was reviewing past tenses when Leo called.
Leo did not understand one exercise, so Mina explained it.
They compared the perfect tenses because the forms looked similar.
Mina feels more confident now, doesn't she?

questions.explanation: For an hour, devam eden çalışmanın süresini verir.

questions.prompt: Why did they compare two tenses?

extra.title: The Practice Test
extra.instructions: Metni sınav gibi oku; her cevap için metinden dilbilgisi kanıtı bul.
paragraphs: Arda takes a practice test every Saturday. Today he is working on a longer paper because his English exam is approaching. He has answered the present-tense questions, but he has not checked them yet. He has been concentrating for forty minutes, so he takes a short break.

Last week, Arda made mistakes because he chose the tense before reading the whole sentence. He was looking at only one word when the teacher explained a better method. Now he reads the time expression, checks whether the action is finished or continuing, and then chooses the verb form. This method has helped him, hasn't it?

questions.prompt: True or False: Arda has checked every answer.
questions.explanation: Metinde has not checked them yet yazıyor.

questions.prompt: Why does Arda take a break?
options: He has been concentrating for forty minutes.
questions.answer: He has been concentrating for forty minutes.
questions.explanation: So sonuç bağlacından önce sebep veriliyor.

questions.prompt: What was Arda doing when the teacher explained a method?
questions.explanation: Past continuous devam eden sahneyi gösterir.

questions.prompt: What does Arda check before choosing a tense?
options: Whether the action is finished or continuing
questions.answer: Whether the action is finished or continuing

listening.title: Four Conversations
listening.instructions: İlk dinlemede konuşmaların zamanını ve ana fikrini bul. İkinci dinlemede tense ve conjunction örneklerini not et.
listening.task: İki past form, iki present form, bir present perfect ve iki conjunction örneği yaz.
listening.followUp: Dinlediğin bir cümleye uygun question tag ekle.
